caseName: Savannah, Florida & Western Railway Co. v. Florida Fruit Exchange
caseNameFull: Savannah, Florida and Western Railway Company v. Florida Fruit Exchange
summary: Appeal from the United States Circuit Court of Appeals for the Fifth Circuit.
attorneys: Mr. John E. Hartridge for appellant. Mr. R. G. Erwin was on the brief., Mr. Charles M. Cooper for appellee.

opinions.author: Brewer
opinions.text:
Mr. Justice Brewer

delivered the opinion of the court. The conclusions announced in the case just decided dispose of this; and for the reasons stated in' that opinion, the judgment of the Court of Appeals is reversed, and the case remanded to the Circuit Court, with instructions to enter a decree for the defendant, dismissing the bill without prejudice.

Mr. Justice Harlan dissented.
